_note: Every on-screen claim traces to a line here. 'grounded' = in the product today; 'vision' = allowed as capability; 'illustrative' = scenario numbers, shown under the 'What you could ask' tag.
grounded: Twelve AI agents: Coordinator, Customer comms, Supplier comms, Outreach, Planner, Acquisition, Pricing, Interpreter, Analytics, Verifier, Sourcing, Market research.
Requests arrive by email, on the website (pick a place on a globe or type an address/coordinates), by API, or via an MCP endpoint for other AI agents.

The signal engine watches NOAA/NWS weather alerts, NASA FIRMS fire detections, USGS earthquakes, NOAA river flood gauges, OpenFEMA disaster declarations, Global Forest Watch deforestation alerts, BLM mining claims, USGS mineral records, and news.
Signals are matched to businesses' sites; one AI-disclosed outreach email goes out with a free sample analysis.
The Planner writes a data spec (area, dates, sensor, method) and checks the Earth index (an H3 hexagon grid of everything measured) first.
Free data first: Sentinel-2 and Landsat. When paid imagery would answer better, agents price it from satellite marketplaces.
Agents quote up to three options; nothing runs until the customer accepts one.
Analysis runs server-side in a sandboxed cloud computer: water extent, burn severity, vegetation change, before/after change detection.
A separate Verifier agent grades every report against a checklist and sends weak ones back.
Reports contain a plain answer, before/after images with capture dates, measurements, a confidence level, every source with dates, limitations, and a human-review note when stakes are high.
Everything is logged on mission control, including every time a human steps in.
Stack: Naïve managed agents, AgentMail, Monid, Neon Postgres.
vision: More sensor types: SAR radar, thermal, hyperspectral, methane, 30 cm commercial optical, night lights, LiDAR elevation.
The Earth index compounds: every answer makes the next one faster and cheaper.
